Learn more In this video Transcript Description How to Become a Certified Public Accountant (CPA) 24Likes2,127Views2025Jan 22 In a world where every financial decision matters, Certified Public Accountants (CPAs) play an indispensable role. They provide critical insights that drive strategic planning and decision-making. As businesses and individuals face increasingly intricate financial challenges, the demand for skilled CPAs continues to rise. CPAs have the flexibility to specialize in areas that align with their passions and interests. Becoming a CPA can open doors to diverse career paths, from public accounting and corporate finance to forensic accounting and consulting. WGU’s flexible and accredited degree programs in accounting and finance can provide a strong educational foundation for a CPA career.
